title: test(runtime): the override/merge binder pin passes 'app:<id>' as packageId, so its "the replaced body answers at no address" half cannot fail
body:
domain:server#1 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg5AUtn9pwa3g2bBqk

Filing gate: ① a test that cannot fail, found by the contract review of PR #32333 (#32245) at `7ce6a5d9`, record 6780831094, nit N6. Left off that head on purpose (a test file is not a prose face).

**Where:** `packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.test.ts`, the override/merge case added by PR #32333.

**What happens:** the case's per-package loop calls the engine with `packageId: 'app:com.qa.share.one'`. The engine's package coordinate is the bare id (`com.qa.share.one`); `app:` is the owner key, not a coordinate. So that call always misses, and `not.toEqual(replaced)` cannot fail. The case still discriminates through its unqualified call, so "bound once" is pinned, but "the replaced body answers at no address" is not.

**Do:** pass the bare package id in the loop; assert the replaced body is unreachable at each package coordinate; ablate once (bind the replaced body under its package) and see red.

**Clause-②:** no (test only); `skip-changeset` if nothing publishes.
**Business reason:** a pin that cannot fail hides a regression of the very binding rule #32333 added.
